title: The declared Azure resource types, by deployment profile
subtitle: A type inventory, not a bill of materials. Existing references and child configuration resources are included; conditional declarations do not mean every deployment creates them.

sections.title: Default gateway and telemetry · existing Foundry account
sections.note: API Management may be created or reused. Logger, API, operations, policy, named values and diagnostics are configuration resources. The role assignment grants the gateway identity access to Foundry.

sections.title: Optional projection · durable entitlement and container-scoped data roles
sections.note: Cosmos DB stores one leased entitlement per identity. Key authentication is disabled. The resolver's reader grant is not the writer's grant.

sections.title: Optional private networking and evaluation runner
sections.note: Create a VNet or use supplied subnets. Private endpoints, private DNS zones, VNet links and zone groups resolve private addresses. The container group is an optional writer/test runner, not a production requirement.

sections.title: Optional resolver · Function host, deployment storage and authentication
sections.note: Flex Consumption runs the resolver. The Function's own storage and deployment container are separate from the entitlement database. Authentication settings restrict callers; publishing credentials are disabled.

sections.title: Optional Turnstile integration · manual apply and hourly export
sections.note: Two Container Apps jobs share a user-assigned identity and a Consumption environment. Turnstile's App Service, PostgreSQL, Event Hubs and support resources are deployed by its separate fork, not by these gateway Bicep files.

sections.title: Optional P50 reports · retention, scoped roles and email
sections.note: Report jobs reuse the network, storage, identity and Container Apps resource types above. These additional declarations control archive lifecycle and dedicated ACS Email. Existing shared network/DNS choices are discovered rather than assumed.

sections.title: Optional AUM service · keyless operational state
sections.note: The independent administrative service adds a Table service and AumState table. Its Function, Blob storage, network endpoints and role assignments use types already shown above; the dedicated service diagram explains authority and write safety.

notice: The architecture check compares this explicit inventory with resource declarations in every infra Bicep file. A new type fails until a diagram source includes it. Saved KQL functions and workbooks are published by scripts; optional Grafana is supplied separately.
